description: Net Pulse's complete IPC surface. Every command the frontend can invoke is named explicitly here — nothing else is reachable, mirroring the old Electron contextBridge allowlist (see preload.js in the legacy electron/ app) but enforced by Tauri's own permission system instead of a hand-written bridge object. No built-in Tauri capabilities (fs, shell, http, dialog, etc.) are granted — this app doesn't need any of them; every network operation goes through the app's own commands below, not a generic plugin.
